cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Before forwarding a surprising claim, you should…
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Media literacy means checking sources, context, evidence and incentives before believing or sharing content.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why can using every resource immediately be risky?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Unexpected needs may appear later. Keeping some time, money or capacity in reserve can make you more resilient.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Use five spare minutes today to revise one useful concept.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to this idea.

meta.source_reference: Verse encouraging even very small amounts of daily learning

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What can a keylogger capture?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Keyloggers can capture passwords as users type them, while other malware may steal credentials stored in browsers or applications.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does privilege escalation mean?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Privilege escalation occurs when an attacker or authorized tester obtains permissions beyond those initially available.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does HTTPS mainly protect while data travels?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: HTTPS uses TLS to protect web traffic against interception and unauthorized modification while it is in transit.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Choose a realistic fixed wind-down time tonight.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to sleep.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What do penetration-testing Rules of Engagement define?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: How the test will be conducted

cards.explain: Rules of Engagement define how an authorized penetration test will be conducted, including agreed boundaries and conditions.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Track one day of spending, even if the amount is small.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to money basics.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which quality do you value most in a close friend?
cards.subtitle: Choose the response closest to your value.

meta.source_reference: True friendship revealed in difficult circumstances

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What happens during cybersecurity incident response?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Incident response organizes preparation, detection, containment, removal and recovery so cybersecurity incidents can be handled systematically.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does multi-factor authentication add to an account?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Multi-factor authentication adds an extra layer of protection to an account beyond its usual login process.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is end-to-end encryption designed to do?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: E2EE is designed so message content can be decrypted only by the communicating endpoints, assuming their devices and keys remain secure.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What distinguishes symmetric encryption?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: It uses the same or closely related secret information

cards.explain: Symmetric encryption uses the same secret key, or closely related secret information, for encryption and decryption. It is generally fast and suitable for large amounts of data.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which service can automatically provide IP configuration to devices?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: DHCP can automatically provide devices with IP configuration information, reducing the need to configure each device manually.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What happens in identity theft?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Identity theft involves illegally using another person's personal information. Protecting personal details can reduce opportunities for this type of misuse.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why can network segmentation improve security?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: It can limit movement between systems

cards.explain: Segmentation separates a network into smaller zones and can reduce an attacker's ability to move from one compromised system to another.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which is more actionable?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Time management works better when priorities are converted into specific next actions and protected time.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Does paying a ransomware demand guarantee data recovery?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: No. Paying a ransom does not guarantee that attackers will restore the victim's data.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: How long is an IPv6 address?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: IPv6 addresses are 128 bits long, while IPv4 addresses are 32 bits long.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why is a suspicious program run in a sandbox?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Sandboxing runs suspicious programs or files in an isolated environment so their behavior can be analyzed more safely.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Before installing unfamiliar software, verify where it came from.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to this idea.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Are needs and wants always the same?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Needs and wants are not always the same. Recognizing the difference is useful when making money decisions.

meta.source_reference: Needs and wants are not always the same.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: When should a password be changed promptly?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: A password should be changed promptly when there is credible evidence it has been compromised.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why know emergency contacts?
cards.subtitle: Connect emergency awareness to the way you think or act.

options.label: Yes — I want to explore this

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does malware persistence mean?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Persistence mechanisms allow malware to remain active or regain execution after restarts or other system changes.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What describes a Man-in-the-Middle attack?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: In a Man-in-the-Middle attack, an attacker positions themselves between communicating parties to intercept or potentially alter communications.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which key should normally remain protected in public-key cryptography?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Asymmetric cryptography uses related public and private keys. The public key can normally be distributed openly, while the private key must be protected.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is a passphrase?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: A passphrase uses multiple words or another longer memorable sequence as a password.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Does a padlock or HTTPS indicator prove a website is trustworthy?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: HTTPS indicates an encrypted connection to the authenticated site. It does not guarantee that the site's content, offers or intentions are trustworthy.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why is random salt added before password hashing?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: To remove the need for hashing

cards.explain: Salting adds random data before password hashing, reducing the effectiveness of attacks that rely on precomputed hashes.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: How does a penetration test differ from a vulnerability assessment?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: A vulnerability assessment mainly identifies and prioritizes weaknesses, while penetration testing attempts to validate whether selected weaknesses can actually be exploited.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What can an authenticator app provide during login?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Authenticator apps can generate temporary authentication codes that provide an additional authentication step beyond a password.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which information usually deserves extra care before sharing online?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Chanakya warns against careless disclosure of secrets. Today, that principle strongly applies to passwords, financial details and sensitive personal information.

meta.source_reference: Verses warning that private information may be exposed

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is an HSM designed to protect?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: A Hardware Security Module is a specialized device designed to protect cryptographic keys and perform cryptographic operations with them.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which activity can be a cybercrime?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Cybercrime is illegal activity involving computers, networks, digital devices or the internet. Hacking a system without permission can be a cybercrime.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Does Zero Trust automatically trust devices inside a network?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: No. Zero Trust does not automatically trust a user or device merely because it is inside a traditional network boundary.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Media literacy
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Media literacy means checking sources, context, evidence and incentives before believing or sharing content.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Summarize the other person’s point before responding.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to conflict resolution.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does PII mean?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Personally Identifiable Information is information that can identify an individual or be linked to that individual.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is the generally unreadable output of encryption called?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Plaintext is the original readable information. Ciphertext is the transformed, generally unreadable output produced by encryption.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does data exfiltration mean?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Data exfiltration means the unauthorized transfer of information from a compromised system.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which set contains three useful health habits?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: Less sleep, no movement, skipped meals

cards.explain: Regular physical activity can support well-being, adequate sleep helps the body and mind function properly, and a balanced diet provides important nutrients.

meta.source_reference: Physical activity, adequate sleep and a balanced diet are described as supporting health, functioning and nutrition.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What may be useful when reporting online abuse or fraud?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Evidence such as relevant messages or screenshots can sometimes be useful when reporting online abuse or fraud.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What four-step rule can guide a safer online decision?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Stop → Think → Verify → Act. Pause before reacting, consider the situation, check what you can, and only then decide what action to take.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What can make an online scholarship offer suspicious?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Scholarship scams may promise financial assistance while seeking unnecessary payments or sensitive information. Treat such requests cautiously and verify the offer.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which step is part of network hardening?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Network hardening reduces unnecessary exposure by securely configuring devices and disabling services that are not needed.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is the basic job of a firewall?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: Permit or block traffic by rules

cards.explain: A firewall permits or blocks network traffic according to security rules, helping control which communications are allowed.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Check whether you reuse the same password across different accounts.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to this idea.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Take a short walk or stretch break after focused study.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to physical activity.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does malware mean?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Malware means malicious software: software intentionally designed to harm, disrupt, spy on, or gain unauthorized access to systems.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which attack systematically tries many possible passwords?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: A brute-force attack systematically tries many possible passwords in an attempt to find the correct one.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Does privacy mean hiding everything?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: No. Healthy privacy means sharing information appropriately. Some things belong with trusted people, some with professionals, and some can be public.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Check the website address before entering a password or payment details.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to this idea.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is an account takeover?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: An account takeover happens when an attacker gains unauthorized control of another person's account.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is a system's attack surface?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: The attack surface is the collection of possible points through which an attacker could try to enter or affect a system.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What can help resolve many everyday conflicts?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Calm communication can help people discuss disagreements and work toward resolving conflict.

meta.source_reference: Conflict can often be resolved through calm communication.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which software-download habit is safer?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Download software from trusted sources. Pirated software can contain malware, creating unnecessary risks for your device and information.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why do small routines matter?
cards.subtitle: Connect physical activity to the way you think or act.

options.label: Yes — I want to explore this

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does encryption do to readable information?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: Transforms it into a protected form

cards.explain: Encryption transforms readable information into a protected form so unauthorized parties cannot easily understand it.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which system can automatically block certain suspicious traffic?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: An IPS can detect suspicious traffic and automatically block or prevent certain attacks. An IDS monitors activity and alerts defenders about suspicious behavior.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What can antivirus or anti-malware software help detect?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Antivirus or anti-malware software can help detect many malicious programs. It is one useful part of safer device use.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is a key benefit of time management?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Time management helps you organize your time so important tasks can be completed on schedule.

meta.source_reference: Time management helps people complete tasks on schedule.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which system can automatically act to block suspicious activity?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: An IDS monitors activity and generates alerts. An IPS can detect suspicious activity and automatically take actions to block it.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Does responsibility matter online too?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Yes. Digital responsibility includes behaving appropriately when interacting and acting online.

meta.source_reference: Digital responsibility includes behaving appropriately online.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What makes ethical hacking ethical?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Ethical hacking is authorized security testing. Testers must have explicit permission and stay within the agreed scope.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why should network devices be updated regularly?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Regular updates for routers, firewalls, switches, wireless access points and other network devices help address known vulnerabilities.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why should livelihood be considered when planning a move?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: A place can be attractive yet unsuitable if you cannot sustainably study, work or meet basic needs there. Opportunity is part of practical planning.

meta.source_reference: Verse warning against living where one cannot earn a livelihood

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why do emotional posts spread quickly?
cards.subtitle: Connect media literacy to the way you think or act.

options.label: Yes — I want to explore this

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does lateral movement mean in cybersecurity?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Lateral movement means moving from one compromised system or account to other resources within an environment.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why can people become part of a cyberattack?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Social engineering manipulates people into revealing information, granting access or taking actions that benefit an attacker.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: When does a data breach occur?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: Sensitive data is exposed without authorization
A user changes their own password

cards.explain: A data breach occurs when protected, confidential or sensitive information is accessed, exposed, stolen or disclosed without authorization.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Where should a student practise cybersecurity testing?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Cybersecurity testing should only be performed where there is clear permission. Ethical hacking labs and CTFs provide legal environments for practising cybersecurity skills.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What makes a stateful firewall different?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: A stateful firewall tracks the state of network connections when deciding whether traffic should be allowed.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: How can one stolen login threaten accounts on other websites?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Credential stuffing involves trying stolen login details on other websites. This is one reason using different passwords for different accounts matters.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: A job offer asks a student for money and personal details. What should raise concern?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Fake job offers can be used to collect personal details or money from students. Online scams often try to trick people into giving away money or information.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does MFA add beyond a password?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Multi-Factor Authentication adds protection beyond a password by combining factors based on something you know, have, or are.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What can polymorphic malware change?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Polymorphic malware can modify aspects of its code or appearance while preserving its malicious functionality.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is the purpose of stress-management skills?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Stress-management skills can help people cope with pressure.

meta.source_reference: Stress-management skills can help people cope with pressure.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What can anti-malware software do?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Anti-malware software can detect, block, quarantine and remove many known or suspicious malicious programs.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which group contains only types of malware?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Malware is software intentionally created for harmful or unauthorized activities. Viruses, worms, Trojans, spyware and ransomware are common malware types.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Sleep is important for…
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Regular sufficient sleep supports attention, learning, mood and physical health.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does IAM control in a cloud environment?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Identity and Access Management controls who or what can access cloud resources.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Learn one small useful thing today and write it in one sentence.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to this idea.

meta.source_reference: Verse urging learning every day, even in small amounts

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does behavior-based malware detection focus on?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Behavior-based detection looks for suspicious actions rather than relying only on known malware signatures.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What happens in a credential-stuffing attack?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: Every password is guessed from scratch
A screen is watched from nearby

cards.explain: Credential stuffing uses stolen username-password combinations to attempt logins on other services, making password reuse especially risky.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does a keylogger record?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: A keylogger records keystrokes entered on a device. Attackers can use captured keystrokes to steal usernames, passwords, and other sensitive information.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What does the CIA Triad stand for?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: The CIA Triad represents three fundamental cybersecurity goals: Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is a phishing message trying to do?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Phishing messages try to trick people into revealing information or taking unsafe actions, so unexpected messages deserve careful checking.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Are a password and a fingerprint the same type of authentication factor?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: No. Passwords and biometric information are different authentication factors. A fingerprint or face scan can also be used to unlock credentials stored on a device.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: How can breach monitoring help account security?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Monitoring for compromised credentials can help organizations respond when passwords appear in known breaches.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What happens in ARP spoofing?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: ARP spoofing involves sending deceptive ARP information to manipulate local network traffic.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Goal setting
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Useful goals connect a meaningful outcome with measurable progress and a clear next action.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: How can you manage many unique passwords?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: A password manager can securely store many unique passwords, reducing the need to reuse the same password across important accounts.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Strengthen an important account with MFA.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to this idea.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is a vulnerability in cybersecurity?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.

options.label: A weakness that could be exploited

cards.explain: A vulnerability is a weakness that a threat actor could exploit. Risk describes the potential for harm when a threat can exploit such a weakness.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Identify two trustworthy people you could contact when you need help.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to this idea.

meta.source_reference: Importance of friends and support during adversity

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Where does personal hygiene fit into everyday life?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Personal hygiene is an important part of taking care of yourself.

meta.source_reference: Personal hygiene is an important part of self-care.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What can ransomware do to your files?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Ransomware can lock or encrypt files and demand money. Keeping important files backed up can help with recovery after ransomware or other data loss.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What role can Command-and-Control infrastructure play?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Command-and-Control, or C2, infrastructure allows some malware to communicate with attacker-controlled systems.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Pick your most important task for today.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to this idea.

meta.source_reference: Setting priorities helps people focus on important tasks.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is a modern alternative to Chanakya's harsh warnings about unreliable people?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Use boundaries rather than hostility. Limit access to private information, money or responsibility when repeated behaviour shows someone is unreliable.

meta.source_reference: Warnings about false friends and harmful associates

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Before acting on an unexpected link or message, use: Think → Check → Verify → Click.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to this idea.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What can DNS spoofing or cache poisoning cause?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: DNS spoofing or cache poisoning can cause users or systems to receive false DNS information instead of the expected name-resolution data.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Physical activity
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Regular physical activity supports cardiovascular health, strength, mobility and mental wellbeing.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Save the appropriate local emergency number in your phone.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to emergency awareness.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Which Sanskrit word means “goal”?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: लक्ष्यम् (lakṣyam) means “goal.” The source illustrates it with “मम लक्ष्यं स्पष्टम् अस्ति” — “My goal is clear.”

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Why are basic household skills useful?
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Basic household skills encourage independence by helping you handle appropriate everyday tasks yourself.

meta.source_reference: Basic household skills encourage independence; cooking simple meals is a useful practical skill.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Back up an important school or personal file.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to this idea.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Sleep
cards.subtitle: Tap to reveal one useful idea.
cards.reveal: Regular sufficient sleep supports attention, learning, mood and physical health.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: Keep passwords out of insecure messages and public documents.
cards.subtitle: A tiny action linked to this idea.

cards.label: LIFE SKILLS
cards.title: What is the modern purpose of keeping emergency savings?
cards.subtitle: Choose quickly, then learn from the explanation.
cards.explain: Chanakya advises saving resources for difficult times. Today, an emergency reserve helps absorb unexpected expenses without guaranteeing that every crisis disappears.

meta.source_reference: Verses advising preservation of wealth against calamity
